description: Reserved Matters Application relating to the layout, scale, appearance, access and landscaping for the development of Plot 43A comprising residential units (Use Class C3) within a building of up to ground plus 8 storeys together with associated amenity space, provision for cycle storage, refuse storage and plant. The application also proposes landscaped open space including a private landscaped courtyard, on street loading bay, on and off street car parking, and a new footway along part of the western extent of Spine Road North. The application is submitted pursuant to Condition 1.3(v) and 2.1 within the Phase 5D sub-phase of planning permission F/04687/13 dated 23/07/2014 (as amended) for the comprehensive mixed-use redevelopment of the Brent Cross Cricklewood Regeneration Area. This application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement of Compliance.
